tasks.label: Configure CMake (Release)
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (-not (Test-Path 'build/CMakeCache.txt')) { $cmake = (Get-Command cmake -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Source -First 1); if (-not $cmake) { $cmake = 'C:\Program Files\CMake\bin\cmake.exe' }; if (-not (Test-Path $cmake)) { throw 'cmake.exe not found' }; & $cmake -S . -B build -G 'Visual Studio 17 2022' -A x64 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } else { Write-Host 'CMake already configured in build/CMakeCache.txt' }

tasks.label: Reconfigure CMake (Release)
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $cmake = (Get-Command cmake -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Source -First 1); if (-not $cmake) { $cmake = 'C:\Program Files\CMake\bin\cmake.exe' }; if (-not (Test-Path $cmake)) { throw 'cmake.exe not found' }; & $cmake -S . -B build -G 'Visual Studio 17 2022' -A x64 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: Build Backend (Release)
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $cmake = (Get-Command cmake -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Source -First 1); if (-not $cmake) { $cmake = 'C:\Program Files\CMake\bin\cmake.exe' }; if (-not (Test-Path $cmake)) { throw 'cmake.exe not found' }; & $cmake --build build --config Release --target uevr vr-plugin-nullifier LuaVR uevr-tests; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: Run Tests
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $ctest = (Get-Command ctest -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Source -First 1); if (-not $ctest) { $ctest = 'C:\Program Files\CMake\bin\ctest.exe' }; if (-not (Test-Path $ctest)) { throw 'ctest.exe not found' }; & $ctest --test-dir build -C Release --output-on-failure; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; dotnet run --project frontend/UEVR.Tests/UEVR.Tests.csproj --configuration Release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: Stage Publish Output
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'publish' | Out-Null; $files = @('build/bin/uevr/UEVRBackend.dll', 'build/bin/uevr/UEVRBackend.pdb', 'build/bin/uevr/openvr_api.dll', 'build/bin/vr-plugin-nullifier/UEVRPluginNullifier.dll', 'build/bin/LuaVR/LuaVR.dll'); foreach ($f in $files) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $f -Destination 'publish' -Force }; $rev = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path (Get-Location) 'publish\revision.txt'), $rev + [Environment]::NewLine, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))

tasks.label: Clean Build
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'build') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'build' -Recurse -Force; Write-Host 'Removed build directory' } else { Write-Host 'build directory does not exist' }
